description: This file defines the class ADODB_Encrypt_MD5 which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using MD5 cryptography within the ADOdb database abstraction layer, specifically for session management. It includes references to external dependencies such as the MD5Crypt class and includes a security guard and file inclusion.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MD5
classes.description: A class providing MD5-based encryption and decryption methods for session management in ADOdb.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data using a provided key via MD5Crypt.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data using a provided key via MD5Crypt.
